meaning: Same employee, same pay month and identical amounts appear on more than one payslip.
money_at_risk_basis: Possible extra payment = (copies - 1) x net pay, split equally over the flagged copies so it is never counted twice.
Deductions above the employee's usual deduction share of gross pay (own previous months; dataset median if none).

meaning: Net pay is exactly zero although the employee had payable days.
money_at_risk_basis: Expected net pay = expected gross pay x (1 - usual deduction share); amount not paid.

meaning: Gross pay is higher than fixed pay for the days paid + overtime + variable pay add up to.
Gross pay is lower than fixed pay for the days paid + overtime + variable pay add up to.
Paid overtime hours exceed the 50-hour policy cap.
money_at_risk_basis: Overtime pay x (hours - cap) / hours: pay attributable to the hours above the cap.

meaning: Overtime was paid to a role that is not overtime-eligible.
Provident fund is 0 although it was deducted in the previous month.
money_at_risk_basis: Provident fund deducted in the previous month.

meaning: Fixed pay is more than twice the median fixed pay of the same role.
money_at_risk_basis: (fixed pay - role median fixed pay) x payable days / days in month.

meaning: Fixed pay rose by more than 50% compared with the previous month.
money_at_risk_basis: (fixed pay - last month's fixed pay) x payable days / days in month.

meaning: Fixed pay fell compared with the previous month.
money_at_risk_basis: (last month's fixed pay - fixed pay) x payable days / days in month.

meaning: A required payroll amount is missing or not a valid number.
money_at_risk_basis: No estimate (the amounts needed are not reliable).

money_at_risk_basis: Not applicable (attendance rows carry no money estimate).

meaning: Five or more consecutive unpaid absence days.
money_at_risk_basis: Not applicable (attendance rows carry no money estimate).
